methods.test_split: tokei 14 code lines in programming languages only. A file under tests/, test/, e2e/, qa/, or functional/, or named *_test/_tests/test_*, counts as tests. Rust lines inside a #[cfg(test)] or #[cfg(all(..., test))] item count as tests. Partition: fuzz paths (fuzz/, fuzz_targets/, src/test/fuzz/); property (path or name contains property/proptest/quickcheck/hypothesis/orange_paper_property); in-source tests (files next to program sources, including in-file #[cfg(test)] and C++ src/test); test-folder tests (remaining files under tests/, test/, e2e/, qa/, or functional/). This is a folder split, not a unit-vs-integration classification. Benches under bench(es)/ are grouped with in-source tests. Vendored and locale paths are excluded. test_insource / test_folder are the canonical fields; test_unit / test_integration are aliases of those values.
methods.fuzz_targets: Declared fuzz targets at the pin, not a count of files in a fuzz directory. C++: invocations of FUZZ_TARGET( and wrappers such as FUZZ_TARGET_DESERIALIZE(, skipping #define lines and lines that continue a macro body (the previous line ends with a backslash). Go: func FuzzXxx(f *testing.F). Rust: cargo-fuzz [[bin]] entries when a fuzz Cargo.toml is present, otherwise fuzz_target! uses (the two Rust counts match on every tree measured here).
methods.vector_files: Files whose path or name looks like a test vector (vector, tx_valid, tx_invalid, script_tests, sighash, bipN) with suffix .json, .csv, or .hex.
methods.spec_files: Documentation or model files whose name looks like a spec (spec, THE_ORANGE_PAPER, orange paper, bipN) with suffix .md, .rst, .txt, .lean, or .tex. LICENSE and contributing files are excluded.
methods.authors_12m: Human commit authors on the landing-share repo set from 2025-11-12 to 2026-11-12 inclusive. Known aliases are merged from a local mailmap (AUTHOR_MAILMAP); the mailmap is not in this repository. Bots and agents are excluded: any name or email containing [bot], merge-script, github-actions, dependabot, Cursor Agent, Claude, Grok Bot Engineer, Devin AI, OpenAI, and other obvious agent identities (rbitcoin-grok, Tau Agent, and similar), plus authors whose email host is localhost, local, or omp. Unique names are compared case-insensitively after the mailmap. If the mailmap is absent, author counts are not measured rather than silently published without alias merging. A shallow clone that does not reach the window start is not measured.
methods.releases_12m: Git tags whose creatordate falls in 2025-11-12 to 2026-11-12. Annotated tags use the tagger date; lightweight tags use the tagged commit date.
methods.ci_workflows: Number of .github/workflows/*.{yml,yaml} files at the pin.
methods.ci_jobs: GitHub Actions jobs at the pin, expanding a static matrix of lists (an include-only matrix is just the include rows, not one implicit job plus those rows; minus exclude/). A fromJSON(needs.job.outputs.x) matrix is expanded when the default non-PR value is written in the same workflow (suite=all, schedule/push flavors and arches, default mutant PARTS) or when the producer reads this tree's fuzz/Cargo.toml [[bin]] list. Unquoted run: scalars that break PyYAML are quoted and retried. If a matrix still cannot be expanded or a file still fails to parse, the cell is partial and the value is a lower bound.
methods.plugin_system: yes / no / partial from the pinned tree's docs. own-team optional modules and independently maintained modules; not found when no source.
methods.blvm_size: Default node first-party crates plus blvm-sdk (blvm-storage-fence lives in the node tree; blvm-sdk-macros lives in the sdk tree). blvm-spec-lock non-test lines are tooling. Tests include spec-lock tests. Same tokei 14 and #[cfg(test)] rules as test_split.
